mechanism: Both agents increase serotonergic activity through different pathways (selegiline via MAO-B inhibition, St. John's Wort via serotonin reuptake inhibition and MAOI properties), creating risk for serotonin syndrome.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if co-administration necessary, monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia) and consider alternative antidepressant.
